# Traceability Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirement-to-evidence chain is defined, bidirectional, and free of orphans
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Chain Definition

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the chain requirement, scenario, design, ADR, task, code, test, validation, documentation, evidence defined with an identifier format for every link? [Completeness, Traceability §1, Spec FR-132] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is bidirectional traversal from any link defined and testable? [Measurability, Spec FR-132 AC] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK003 - Do the matrix rows cover every FR and NFR group with no uncovered ID? [Completeness, Traceability §4] [M, G0] {Detects: orphan-requirement}
- [ ] CHK004 - Are all ADR identifiers (001..027) present in the traceability tables? [Consistency, Spec DEC-106] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the rule defined that downstream columns stay "pending" until real artifacts exist, with no pre-filled value? [Clarity, Traceability intro] [M, G0]

## Orphan Detection

- [ ] CHK006 - Is an orphan requirement defined (no scenario, design, test, or evidence) with a detecting check? [Coverage, Spec FR-132 NAC] [M, G0] {Detects: orphan-requirement}
- [ ] CHK007 - Is an orphan task defined (no cited requirement or ADR) with a detecting check? [Coverage, Traceability §2] [M, G0] {Detects: orphan-task}
- [ ] CHK008 - Do all tasks in tasks.md (once generated) cite at least one FR, NFR, or ADR and a test? [Traceability, Constitution X] [M, G1] {Detects: orphan-task}
- [ ] CHK009 - Is orphan implementation defined (code without an Implements header or requirement) with a detecting check? [Coverage, Traceability §2] [M, G0] {Detects: orphan-implementation}
- [ ] CHK010 - Is an orphan test defined (a test citing no real requirement) with a detecting check? [Coverage, ADR-012 tags] [M, G0] {Detects: orphan-test}
- [ ] CHK011 - Must gaps be shown explicitly and never hidden or reported as complete? [Measurability, Spec FR-132 NAC] [M, G0]

## Lineage and Evidence

- [ ] CHK012 - Is decision lineage traceable (DEC ids to affected requirements, ADRs, and artifacts)? [Coverage, Spec Decision Record] [M, G0] {Detects: missing-decision-lineage}
- [ ] CHK013 - Must evidence items cite requirement IDs and carry content hashes? [Coverage, Observability §6] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is run-level lineage (export) defined in addition to source-level traceability? [Coverage, Traceability §2] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is a link from commits to requirements or intent defined? [Gap, Constitution X, POL-TRC-005] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are policy outcomes and exceptions part of the trace evidence? [Coverage, POL-CHG-007] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the trace report format defined (machine-readable and readable)? [Completeness, Quickstart §8] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is automatic extraction of constitution MUSTs labelled backlog? [Coverage, Plan §6.1 BL-11] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
